research.notes:
## 1. Guidance and results

- Q3 revenue was $127.6B, up 25%. Cloud revenue rose 103% to $30.7B. Search & other rose 12%. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001652044/000165204426000080/googexhibit991q32026.htm
- EPS was $2.12 against about $3.02 expected, a large miss. Sources differ on revenue versus consensus:
  - Investing.com says revenue beat by about $380M. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-alphabet-q3-2026-profit-miss-sparks-10-afterhours-drop-93CH-4981037
  - MarketBeat says revenue missed a $127.97B estimate. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-10-28-alphabet-inc-stock/
  - SiliconAngle cites adjusted EPS of $2.67 and a $128.22B revenue target. — 2026-10-28 — https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/28/alphabets-stock-sinks-after-shocking-investors-with-top-and-bottom-line-miss/
- The EPS miss was driven partly by an $8.2B unrealized loss on the SpaceX investment. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.benzinga.com/news/26/10/62679903/alphabet-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript
- Operating income was $40.6B against $43.19B expected. — 2026-10-28 — https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/28/alphabets-stock-sinks-after-shocking-investors-with-top-and-bottom-line-miss/
- 2026 capex guidance of $195–205B was reiterated, and 2027 capex is expected to rise significantly. Q3 capex was $51.4B and free cash flow was –$9.1B. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-alphabet-q3-2026-profit-miss-sparks-10-afterhours-drop-93CH-4981037
- Cloud backlog was $561B, up from $514B in Q2. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-10-28-alphabet-inc-stock/
- The stock fell about 10% after hours, to $288.35 from a $322.22 close. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.investing.com/news/transcripts/earnings-call-transcript-alphabet-q3-2026-profit-miss-sparks-10-afterhours-drop-93CH-4981037
- Alphabet has a $40B at-the-market stock offering and a $10B Berkshire Hathaway private placement. The offering was expected to begin in Q3. The announcement date is not stated. — date unknown — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001652044/000119312526251733/d160205dfwp.htm

## 3. Litigation and regulation

- Google filed its D.C. Circuit brief challenging the Search remedies (data-sharing and syndication). The DOJ and states have cross-appealed. — 2026-10-26 (MLex report) — https://www.pymnts.com/cpi-posts/google-challenges-us-order-to-share-search-data-with-competitors/
- Ad-tech case: the parties' proposed final judgments were due October 2. The remedy takes effect 60 days after the judge signs the order. — 2026-10-02 — https://www.adexchanger.com/platforms/the-court-just-unsealed-judge-brinkemas-remedies-decision-in-the-google-ad-tech-antitrust-case-heres-your-tldr/
- The EU DMA fines total €890M (€460M for search self-preferencing, €430M for Google Play anti-steering). The Commission said it is "in dialogue" with Google on its response. — 2026-10-14 — https://www.marketscreener.com/news/eu-commission-is-in-dialogue-with-google-over-fines-spokesperson-says-ce785dd2dd80f226
- The €430M Play decision (dated 2026-07-23) was published in the Official Journal. It sets a 60-day compliance deadline, with periodic penalties for non-compliance. — 2026-10-23 — https://eulawlive.com/dma-summary-of-european-commissions-decision-fining-alphabet-e430-million-for-failing-to-comply-with-anti-steering-obligation-published-in-oj/
- Q3 free cash flow included a $5.2B cash payment for an EC fine. The payment date is not given. — date unknown — https://theglobeandmail.com/investing/markets/stocks/GOOGL/pressreleases/8518440/alphabet-googl-q3-2026-earnings-call-transcript
- Google's Play Store antitrust case is heading to South Korea's top court. I saw only the headline. — 2026-10-26 — https://www.pymnts.com/cpi-posts/google-challenges-us-order-to-share-search-data-with-competitors/

## 4. Customer concentration

- Anthropic is Google's largest TPU customer, with up to 1M TPUs agreed in October 2025. Broadcom detailed a $63B Blackstone- and bank-backed vehicle to buy TPUs and lease them to Anthropic for five years. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.cnbc.com/2026/10/28/google-alters-cloud-playbook-turning-to-partners-to-sell-more-ai-chips.html
  - A dev.to post dates the Anthropic deal to Oct 22, 2026. CNBC's coverage is dated 2025-10-23, so that post looks wrong.
- Oracle will make TPUs available to outside customers for the first time. CNBC confirmed OpenAI also plans to buy TPUs. — 2026-10-27 — https://www.briefs.co/news/google-pushes-tpus-beyond-its-own-cloud-tapping-oracle-to-wi/
- A reported $200B, five-year Anthropic commitment would be over 40% of the Q1 backlog. That is a secondary source, and the report dates to May 5, which is outside the window. — 2026-05-05 — https://www.bitsminds.com/news/anthropic-200b-google-tpu-cloud-five-year-deal-2026
- The CFO said maximum contractual obligations may overstate spend because some agreements have variable pricing and volume flexibility. — 2026-10-28 — https://www.cnbc.com/investingclub/2026/10/28/our-next-steps-for-alphabet-stock-after-earnings-disappoint-at-nearly-every-turn.html

I found no open-market sales or 10b5-1 sales in the window. All items below are vesting, tax-withholding or gifts.

## 6. Product and competitive

- Gemini 4 Argon launched globally, at $2/$10 per million input/output tokens until Nov 30. — 2026-10-13 — https://nerdschalk.com/gemini-4-carbon-public-release-date-what-google-has-announced/

writeup.headline: Alphabet rates Hold: strong growth and a net-cash balance sheet offset by a weak FCF-based valuation and soft trend.
writeup.thesis: Alphabet scores 57, a Hold, 8 points short of Buy and 13 points above Sell. The business side is strong: latest-quarter revenue growth of 24.6% year on year, TTM revenue growth of 22.2%, an operating margin of 33.3% and a net-cash balance sheet that scores 100. Valuation is the main drag at 22. P/FCF of 203.5x is high in absolute terms because the FCF margin is only 4.2%, and the FCF yield sits 4.5 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield. Against its own history the stock is labelled expensive overall: P/FCF is more expensive than at every one of the last 61 month-ends, while P/S and EV/EBIT are near the middle of that range. The trend score of 43 also holds the rating back, with the price 19.3% below its 52-week high and the shares 16.1 pp behind SPY over the last 126 trading days.
key_risks: Heavy capex keeps free cash flow thin: the FCF margin is 4.2% and P/FCF is 203.5x, and 2027 capex is expected to rise significantly.
AI Mode is a stated headwind to search revenue, Alphabet's core business.
Weak price trend: the price is 4.8% below its 200-day average and 16.9 pp behind QQQ over the last 126 trading days.
Post-earnings analyst price-target cuts and a downgrade, plus an EPS miss tied partly to an $8.2B unrealized SpaceX loss.
Ongoing legal matters, including the appeal of the U.S. Search remedies and the €430M EU Play decision.
what_would_change: Up to Buy (needs 8 more points): free cash flow recovering as capex growth moderates, which would lift the valuation score from 22.
Up: a turn in the trend score from 43, with the price moving back above its 50- and 200-day averages and catching up with SPY and QQQ.
Down to Sell (would need a 13-point drop): revenue growth slowing sharply from 24.6%, or search weakness eroding the 33.3% operating margin.
Down: further negative news on guidance, analyst actions or competition pulling the news score below 58.
